description: Defines recovery actions and thresholds for deployment failures detected by the AI runtime agent.

no_active_deployment.description: No active deployment found — deployments/current symlink missing or dangling
no_active_deployment.recommended_action: Activate an available deployment or deploy from a release package

no_previous_deployment.description: No previous deployment available for rollback — single point of failure
no_previous_deployment.recommended_action: Deploy a new version to establish rollback chain

sha256_mismatch.description: One or more files fail SHA256 integrity check
sha256_mismatch.recommended_action: Re-download or re-build release package, re-deploy

manifest_missing.description: RELEASE_MANIFEST.json not found in active deployment

manifest_invalid.description: RELEASE_MANIFEST.json exists but is malformed JSON

folders_missing.description: One or more required source folders missing from deployment
folders_missing.recommended_action: Verify deployment extraction, re-deploy if corrupted

json_outputs_broken.description: Required JSON output files missing or invalid

session_corruption.description: Recent deployment sessions report integrity failures
session_corruption.recommended_action: Audit session history, verify deployment integrity
